senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; קָרַח)baldness; ק׳ הכרם razed portion of a vineyard.
units: Kil. IV, 1, v. קָרַח Hif.; a. e.

senses.gloss: smooth back or inside of cloth; worn cloth. Sifra Thazr., Par. 5, ch. XV בקָרַחְתּוֹ אלו השחקים b’ḳaraḥto (Lev. XIII, 55) means worn cloth, opp. גַּבַּחַת.
a leprous affection on the back of the head (making it bald).
units: Neg. X, 10 איזו היא ק׳ מן הקדקד וכ׳ which portion of the head is meant by ḳaraḥath? From the crown sliding backward &c.; Tosef. ib. IV, 9; Sifra l. c. ch. X; a. fr.
